comments.note: views/strategy.js renderStrategyList — visionStatus(repo) uses 'repo.vision' (expecting the full { short_term, mid_term, long_term } object), but API.listRepos() returns RepoListItem which only carries 'has_vision: boolean' (no 'vision' property). BLOCKING BUG 1 — views/strategy.js renderStrategyDetail save handler (lines ~265-269): Vision fields are serialized as trimmed strings regardless of whether the user cleared them. When a textarea is empty, (document.getElementById('vision-short').value || '').trim() produces ''. This empty string is sent in the PUT payload as: { vision: { short_term: '', mid_term: '', long_term: '' } }. However StrategicVisionSchema (src/schema/repository-registry.ts) validates each horizon as z.string().min(1).nullable() — empty strings are explicitly rejected with a validation error. The file-level comment in api-repos.ts documents this: 'empty strings are rejected'. Result: a user who clears any vision textarea and clicks Save will get a 400 error ('Invalid request body') — the field cannot be cleared through the UI. Fix: convert empty strings to null before sending: short_term: (document.getElementById('vision-short').value || '').trim() || null. Apply the same pattern to mid_term and long_term.

BLOCKING BUG 2 — views/strategy.js renderStrategyDetail save handler (line ~264): The payload always includes folder_names: collectFolderNamesFromDOM(). If the user removes all folder entries, collectFolderNamesFromDOM() returns []. The backend RepoUpdateBodySchema validates folder_names as z.array(z.string().min(1)).min(1).optional() — an empty array is rejected with a 400 validation error (fieldError on folder_names). Result: a user who removes all folder names and clicks Save will get a 400 error and cannot save. This is a behavioral trap because the 'Remove' button works correctly for individual entries, but the final save silently breaks when the last entry is removed. Fix: before constructing the payload, check if collectFolderNamesFromDOM() is empty. Either (a) show a client-side validation error ('At least one folder name is required') before calling the API — consistent with how the Add Repository form validates empty ID — or (b) omit folder_names from the payload entirely when empty so the field is left unchanged (partial update semantics). Option (a) is preferable for clarity.

Minor readability note (non-blocking): In renderStrategyList, the inner function is named renderList while the outer function is renderStrategyList. This is functionally fine but slightly inconsistent naming — a future refactor could rename the inner function to renderListContent or similar. Already noted by Developer in implementation pipeline.
